calls.statement:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n, COUNT(DISTINCT sales_line_id) AS d_id, COUNT(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) AS d_rl,
 MIN(etl_loaded_at), MAX(etl_loaded_at), SUM(CASE WHEN quantity<=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS nonpos
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
WHERE s.store_id=102 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27'

SELECT p.sku, p.product_name, p.category, SUM(f.quantity) AS units, COUNT(*) AS n_lines, COUNT(DISTINCT f.sales_line_id) AS dist_lines, COUNT(DISTINCT p.product_key) AS versions
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
WHERE s.store_id=102 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27' AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY units DESC LIMIT 10

calls.statement:
SELECT (SELECT SUM(units_sold) FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE store_id=102 AND business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27') AS rpt_units,
 (SELECT SUM(net_sales_before_returns) FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE store_id=102 AND business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27') AS rpt_net,
 (SELECT SUM(f.quantity) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key WHERE s.store_id=102 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test' AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27') AS fact_units,
 (SELECT SUM(f.net_amount) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key WHERE s.store_id=102 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test' AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27') AS fact_net,
 (SELECT MAX(quantity) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key WHERE s.store_id=102 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27') AS maxq

calls.statement:
SELECT f.sale_date, SUM(f.quantity) AS fact_units, ANY_VALUE(r.units_sold) AS rpt_units
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
LEFT JOIN rpt_daily_store_sales r ON r.store_id=102 AND r.business_date=f.sale_date
WHERE s.store_id=102 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test' AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27'
GROUP BY 1 HAVING SUM(f.quantity)<>ANY_VALUE(r.units_sold) ORDER BY 1

SELECT cp.sku, cp.product_name, SUM(f.quantity) AS units_sold
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
WHERE s.store_id = 102 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
  AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period = 5
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY units_sold DESC, cp.sku
LIMIT 3
